hypothesis_source: First-principles restatement 2026-09-11: the trade is a right-side trigger, not a VCP label. Sequence-2 buy-all of RS>=85 on dual-regime days lost at 10/20-day date-EW vs market and vs same-day eligible names. All-market trend_breakout already failed (744 trades, 21% win, -3.51% mean). This round tests whether a fresh 20-session-high breakout inside the watch list beats the same-day watch names that did not break out.
distinct_from_failed_representations: Not VCP/cup/flag. Not all-market trend_breakout. Not sequence-2 buy-all of the watch list. Difference from v1/v2: the watch list is not traded; the event is price leaving the prior-20-session high after a 20-bar cooldown. Reuse shipped fresh_20d_breakout_opportunity_mask. Do not scan 20.
exposure: Training 2016-01-01 through 2022-12-31. Fills and 5/10/20-day labels must not cross 2022-12-31. 2023+ is exposure only if computed.

watch_list.eligibility: SH/SZ, non-ST name tokens, listing session age > 30, raw_close 3-300, amount >= 20e6
watch_list.role: look-at set, not a buy-all book

trigger.definition: First liquid close above the prior 20 valid-bar high after a 20-bar cooldown. Shipped function, not a new detector.

control: Same-day watch-list names without that breakout. Real same-day set.

pass_fail.pass: Training 10-day and 20-day date-EW net of the breakout subset is not worse than same-day watch names without the breakout (spread >= 0). Still report vs market; vs-market is not the pass line.
pass_fail.fail: Rewrite only the breakout event with a mechanistic difference. Stay on layer 3. Do not add VCP. Do not scan the 20-day window. Do not skip to pullback as the selector.
pass_fail.not_claimed: No live qualification, no clean 2023-2026 OOS.
